events.text: The Dowager Fabergé egg was made under the supervision of Peter Carl Fabergé.

events.text: The egg was made for Nicholas II of Russia.

events.text: Nicholas II presented the egg to his mother, the Dowager Empress Maria Feodorovna, on Easter 1898.

events.text: The Imperial Pelican Fabergé egg was one of ten Imperial eggs sold by the Antikvariat to Armand Hammer in New York City.

events.quote: In 1930 , the Imperial Pelican Fabergé egg , with the eight oval miniatures , was one of ten Imperial eggs sold by the Antikvariat to Armand Hammer

events.text: The egg was purchased by Lillian Thomas Pratt from Hammer Galleries.
